title: Certify the idle rank-cap sensitivity of the selected packing endpoint (no new kappa)
body:
Scoped pricing result, independently reproduced. **No new κ, no supplier and no selected-frontier change.**

The reviewed packing ceiling for the selected complex word caps every idle repacking at κ < 0.001687202646, i.e. +0.869% over the selected κ. That cap uses idle rank 51 (the outer halving guard limit, `2·51² < 73² ≤ 2·52²`), while the selected word only ever uses idle ranks up to 48. This PR prices the gap: it certifies the endpoint of the optimal integer idle packing for every legal idle rank cap, so the physical owner/hosting question can be judged against its actual return.

## What is established, and at what strength

Model: the selected per-call uniform local word (`{1:2412, 2:418, 3:432, 4:142, 5:82, 8:8}`), 144 calls, 14,336 live data families, PR1012 coverage `rank mass = 72W + 64N`, idle mass 237,024, width 73. The endpoint is the root of `(1/W)·Σ n_r (r/m)^(1-a) = 1`.

Certified lower bounds on the gain over the selected endpoint `a_c`:

| Legal idle rank cap | Optimal aggregate integer packing | certified gain over `a_c` | κ gain |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| 51 (guard) | 4647×51 + 27 | **+0.870319%** | +0.868851% |
| 50 | 4740×50 + 24 | +0.714648% | +0.713444% |
| 49 | 4837×49 + 11 | +0.556373% | +0.555438% |
| 48 (attested) | 4938×48 | +0.395842% | +0.395178% |
| 47 | 5043×47 + 3 | +0.231630% | +0.231242% |
| 46 | 5152×46 + 32 | +0.064600% | +0.064492% |
| ≤ 45 | — | none | none |

**Ranks 49 to 51 carry 54.5% of the quoted headroom.** At the largest rank the selected word itself attests, the certified headroom is +0.396%, not +0.87%. Below cap 46 the optimal integer packing is worse than the selected word's own idle histogram.

Also certified at cap 51: forcing each call to reach its own optimum drops the gain to +0.784307%; carrying the 27-unit residue in rank-1 children instead of a single rank-27 child costs 0.003 percentage points.

Everything is a pricing statement under the stated model. It allows fractional counts and every repacking, and checks no physical hostability, owner-family, restoration or consumer cost. A gain exists only if a legal packing realizes the histogram.

## Related open work

Open PR #3729 (`research/complex-idle-integrality-ceiling`) prices the same selected word with per-call integer idle counts (each call packs `1646 = 32·51 + 14`). **Agreement on the per-call row:** its published per-call ceiling `a < 0.001688603446527` lies inside this PR's independent certified per-call bracket `[0.0016886034465262156, 0.0016886034465271038]`, its quoted κ gain `+0.782985%` equals this PR's certified per-call κ gain exactly, and both find the same per-call optimum (`32×51 + 14` per call, `{51:4608, 14:144}` aggregate). **What differs:** this PR prices that premise as one row of a cap table, not as the corrected ceiling — the aggregate rows pool the idle mass across calls (`4647×51 + 27` at cap 51), which the per-call premise forbids, and only the aggregate rows are comparable with the selected word's own idle histogram (`4866` rank-48 units is not divisible by 144). Which premise the physical invoice realizes is a separate open question, raised for the record by the peer audit in PR #3747 and not adjudicated here. PR #3729 is unmodified and was not commented on.

## Independent reproduction

The package uses its own rational enclosure chain (`enclosures.py`: atanh logarithms, positive Taylor exponential, directed rounding to 2^-200) and reproduces:

- the published ceiling bracket and κ cap (independently certified bracket `[0.0016900541090878463, 0.0016900541090887344]`, 11% narrower than the published 1e-15 grid, overlapping);
- the published per-call integer ceiling `0.001688603446527` (contained in the independent bracket `[0.0016886034465262156, 0.0016886034465271038]`, and see the related-work note above);
- the unrestricted integer optimum `{51:4647, 27:1}` and its gap to the fractional relaxation;
- the selected endpoint `a_c` (bracket `[0.0016754626768076, 0.0016754626768085]`; the exact moment at the published `a_c` is `1 − (1.30 ± 0.06)e-24`, i.e. the published value is a truncation of the root) and the exact relation `κ = a_c/(1+a_c) = 0.00167266019707691866`, whose 18-digit truncation is the published κ.

## Controls

Nine controls, all certified, none sampled: halving guard admits 51 and rejects 52; the selected histogram exceeds one at the published ceiling; the published and independent ceiling brackets overlap and the published κ cap is not below the independent one; the published endpoint lies in its bracket and its exact moment is below one by less than 1e-23; cap monotonicity over all 21 caps; the same mass at rank 1 prices worse; the aggregate optimum strictly beats the per-call optimum at cap 51; and three refused inputs (rank-52 child, idle mass off by one, negative count).

## Reproduce

```sh
python3.12 -B research/idle-rank-cap-sensitivity/verify.py
python3.12 -B research/idle-rank-cap-sensitivity/verify.py --write
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/idle-rank-cap-sensitivity
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/idle-rank-cap-sensitivity --check-source-history
```

Standard library only; the registered hook takes about 11 s locally under CPython 3.12.

## Scope, limits and remaining obligations

One fixed local word, template, coverage law and halving guard. Not a bound for other local words, port counts, templates, coverage laws or outer recipes. No physical hosting, owner-family, restoration, consumer or supplier claim; not a multiplication theorem. The physical legality of rank-49 to rank-51 idle children stays open, and that is exactly the question the table prices.

Base: canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. Predecessor credit: the selected complex supplier, its endpoint, the coverage identity, the fractional packing ceiling and the integer-optimum/stability results belong to their credited authors (pins in `SOURCES.json`). This PR adds the cap-sensitivity table, the independent enclosure chain and the controls. Produced by Nick Petalas with AI assistance. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

Merge danger: adds one opt-in research package and its declared replay; it changes no supplier, selected result or shared implementation.
